Sunday Club Rides

London, United Kingdom · Richmond Park · Road

No-drop

Sunday Club Rides is a road group ride in London, United Kingdom. It rolls every Sunday at 9:20 am local time from Richmond Park (the club's Sunday start, given on its Meetup events and website). Pace: steadies, Steadies+ and Inters groups; 65 to 130 km. No-drop.

For visitors

Join the Meetup group for the start point. The club asks new riders to come to a new-members lap first (monthly, in Richmond Park). Lights in the dark months.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before the meet time. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace: steadies, Steadies+ and Inters groups; 65 to 130 km. It's no-drop: if you fall off the back, someone waits. That's the point of a group ride.
Check
Look at @rprouleurs the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Sunday Club Rides group ride

The club's main rides, with several ability groups leaving together. They head out into the Surrey hills and finish at a local pub. The club says it is inclusive and that no one gets left behind, and it holds a new-members session once a month in the park.
